arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected originating from external IP 185.220.101.42, which conducted a network scan on an internal IT asset (WS-IT-101 at 10.0.2.15). The attacker likely leveraged compromised helpdesk credentials to pivot laterally and perform pass-the-hash attacks against 23 user accounts in the Finance OU. Despite detection of suspicious scanning activity and anomalous authentication patterns, automated credential revocation via IAM/PAM systems was denied due to lack of direct evidence linking the source to the targeted accounts. No malware was found in associated files, but lateral movement and privilege escalation are highly probable.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 initiated a SYN scan on internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101), detected and logged by IDS.
Successful authentication from 10.0.2.15 to domain controller (10.0.1.1) using CORP\helpdesk credentials.
UEBA system flagged low-risk anomalies for user jdoe; no immediate action taken.
SIEM correlation identified 23 authentication events linked to Finance OU from suspicious origin.
Attempt to revoke compromised credentials via IAM/PAM system failed due to approval and evidence validation requirements.

arguments.summary: A credential compromise incident initiated via a malicious RDP connection from an external IP (91.219.236.174) led to the deployment of Cobalt Strike Beacon on workstation WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15). The attacker leveraged cached credentials to move laterally, necessitating broad credential revocation across the Finance department and ultimately the entire domain. Detection was delayed due to lack of monitoring for credential dumping and anomalous RDP usage. Containment actions included blocking the C2 server and initiating full scans, though critical IAM and firewall changes were initially denied.

timeline.description: External IP 91.219.236.174 conducts Nmap SYN scan on internal asset 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged by IDS.
Successful RDP login to WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) using compromised credentials for user j.martinez.
Cobalt Strike Beacon (hash: a1b2c3d4...) deployed and established C2 beaconing to 198.51.100.23.
Sandbox analysis confirms malicious nature of payload, identifies C2 infrastructure and behaviors.
Firewall rule deployed to block outbound traffic to C2 server 198.51.100.23.
Full EPP scan initiated on WS-IT-101; no threats detected (likely evaded).
Proposed credential revocation for j.martinez and lateral accounts denied by approval system.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration from Cobalt Strike Beacon"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-08"
    strings:
        $config_start = "beacon" wide ascii
        $cfg_xor_key = { 00 00 00 00 } // Common XOR key patterns
        $http_get = "GET /" wide ascii
        $http_post = "POST /" wide ascii
    condition:
        $config_start at 0..100 and all of ($http_*)
}
